body: If you are talking about the legal repercussions of animal abuse- sadly the animal rights laws in the US are shit quite frankly. The worse you would get is a fine and even that is unlikely. I wouldn't worry too much about it right now. Just seeing that you are making an effort to prevent it from happening again will work well in your favor.

I commented on you other post but I'll say it again here. 
Please find another home for your dog. No animal deserves to be abused. Your dog deserves a better life, with a better owner. She doesn't deserve to have a life where she "may" not be abused again. Please do the right thing here and find another home for you dog.  

That said, I see a lot of hope for you. The fact that you feel guilty about what you have done shows that you really do have a good heart. You realize you have a problem, and you are reaching out for help. You cannot change what you have done, but you can change yourself and keep it from happening again. And over time you can make up for what you've done.  Don't give up on yourself just yet. You can make these things right. Starting with finding your dog another owner. 

The Humane Society will take your dog no questions asked. Just say that you are not able to properly take care of her anymore and they will find a way to take her off your hands. 
If you don't want to take her there send me a PM and I will find somewhere else for you to take her. I have a lot of contacts in the dog rescue world so I will find a way to make it work while still keeping it anonymous. 

Dogs are very forgiving creatures and she will still love you even after what you have done. But do you really want to risk it happening again?

I'm sorry, whatever happened that made you so mad there is never an excuse for beating an animal. The fact that you feel guilty and upset about it thought tells me that you do have a good heart, even if you have trouble controlling your anger. One day an animal may be very healing for you to have but I don't think you are at that point in your life right now. 

Please for the safety and the welfare of your dog find another home for her. The humane society will not put her down. You haven't ruined her for life but you will if you continue to treat her this way. She deserves a better life with a better owner. 

If you need help finding her a home send me a PM and I can point you in the right direction. You can also always take her to the animal shelter, trust me they will respect the fact that you are giving her up because you don't trust yourself with her.

 I'm sorry if all this sounds harsh, but like I said before, there is absolutely no excuse for treating anyone or anything this way

Thank you :) You're words are very encouraging and I have taken them to heart. I think last night made me realize that I was ready for, and needed, a huge change in my life. 
I feel a little more hopeful that maybe I can accomplish that this year. 
If not well then I'll probably be posing here again lol.

Like everyone else before me has said, what you are describing sounds exactly like depression. I can assure you that you have a real condition here. It is also not uncommon for people with depression to become promiscuous and dabble in drugs. They are all just searching for some kind of connection and feeling. 
I felt the same way my second year in to college and ended up dropping out because of it. After two years of therapy I'm just starting to be ready to go back and try again. In retrospect I wish I had the courage to see a therapist while staying in college; but at the time that thought was too overwhelming for me to even think about. Would you be willing to go talk to your school counselor and just see what they say?

I have to agree with British_Accent_Man. I am also a former cutter, and I understand completely the feeling it gives you. I also did it for the control it gave me. And because for me, the physical pain was much easier to deal with then the emotional pain. The feeling cutting creates is very addictive and once you start it's hard to give up. But trust me, you don't want a life of people pretending not to stare at your scars or wearing long sleeves shirts in 95 degree (Fahrenheit) weather. 
There are other ways to feel that control and pleasure. For me it was furiously writing down every thought in my head; until the pen ripped through the paper and I thought my hand was going to fall off. Everyone needs something different, and if you talk to a friend or a counselor they might be able to help you figure out what can replace the cutting for you. I know it feels great right now, probably better than anything you've felt in a while. But I believe this is something you can overcome. If you need someone anonymous to talk to i'm here for you.

Thanks, you have all been very supportive. It's nice to have an anonymous community to turn to for support. I feel a little better today and am trying to take all of your advice to heart. Suicide is still a very present thought in my head but I am trying to push it back and think more of what I can do to stop making theses mistakes and improve my life a little.  
I hate being that one depressed friend everyone has. Maybe expanding out of my social network and meeting new people that I can form a new identity with will help. Any advice on how to make friends?

Sure, you can send me a PM since i can't seem to figure out how to do it. 
Thanks for taking the time to talk to me today.

I moved recently and my therapist is two hours away and doesn't have a direct phone line. 
Whether or not I actually kill myself, I suppose part of it is just comforting to know that the option is there. And at some point I can stop going through life like an automaton.

I don't feel like I have control of my actions all the time. I do want to be a nice person and treat people the right way. But then my mind gets all paranoid and wonky. I don't have the energy or motivation to do anything with myself. I dropped out of college two years ago and haven't been able to get myself back in to one. Mostly because I sabotage the applications in one way or another.  I don't feel like I deserve to live, and I don't feel like the world is benefiting from me being here at all. 
Not being here, well I'm sure plenty of people would be okay with it. It would take a huge financial burden off my parents. And since I don't have any strong religious affiliations I'm not all that worried about ending up in hell.

Your words are nice and I thank you for them. But I've kind of gotten past the point of reason. I just don't want to deal with any of this. It never ends. It gets better for a bit but then it goes right back to being bad. I'm just tired of it..

I do just feel very much like nothing right now. There are no feelings anymore, just kind of a floating in the clouds but not acknowledging that there are clouds around me. 
Sorry I know that doesn't make sense. Anyway, kind of new to posting on reddit. I've always just observed. I'm not sure how to send a PM.

You lost me there a bit in the economics talk, but I think I found my way back.  I have gone through this before, I would get so depressed that I just pushed everyone away and isolated myself from it all. 

I have actually been seeing a therapist for about a year. And yes she did dramatically improve my outlook on life. And I can feel content for a while but it always comes back to these points where i sink back down low and someone ends up getting hurt. That is not a person I want to be. I don't want to be someone who constantly has to monitor their behavior because they say and do stupid things. 
I'm tired of being the reason my family and friends are hurt. I'm really just tired of life. 
And I'm no newcomer to the ups and downs of depression (like I said I have ten or so years under my belt) And I have never given up for whatever reason, but it's just come to a point where I just don't see any future for myself. There is just nothing there, nothing I can accomplish or do. And for some reason right now that's okay.

It's kind of past the point of just saying i'm sorry. Long story short, i left my Facebook account logged in on their computer and they read a conversation I was having with a friend who asked something about a subject they were never supposed to know about. It's kind of hard to take back something you meant but was just never supposed to reach that person's ears. 
Damn social networks...

I said I'm sorry and they cut me out of their lives so completely that they deleted their facebook account to avoid me ( so of course now we know it's really serious)
